GRADE 4 AGRICULTURE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Time: 96 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. This is an advanced revision paper.
2. Show working where needed.
3. Answer all questions.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

   C. Water Conservation is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Water Conservation.
